description: Run by .github/workflows/renovate.yaml (self-hosted, as our own GitHub App). Nothing is automerged: a merge to main is a release (code) or a deploy (platform/, through Flux), so every update is a PR, checked by CI, merged by hand.

flux.description: HelmRelease chart versions, OCIRepository and GitRepository tags.

kubernetes.description: Container images in plain manifests (Authelia, hello).

customManagers.description: Versions with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment on the line above, in workflows.
Container images pinned in the controller's Go code (the Postgres its databases run).
The same in Go code: the Paketo builder and pack image mcloud build uses (here and in run-deploy.yaml), the curl and Postgres images.

packageRules.description: The Paketo builder is released every few days; one PR a month is plenty.
Providers and modules come from the OpenTofu registry, like `tofu init` (and the lock files) use.
One PR for the UpCloud provider across all four stacks.
Local tooling and CI actions deploy nothing: one PR each.
kubectl must stay within one minor version of the cluster; minor bumps wait for a cluster upgrade.
Knative supports upgrading one minor version at a time: one PR per minor, merged in order.
